item.title: Cisco ASA and FTD Flaw Exploited in the Wild Can Trigger Remote DoS
item.summary: Cisco has warned that a new vulnerability impacting Secure Firewall Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) Software and Secure Firewall Threat Defense (FTD) Software has been exploited in the wild.
